text:
abby: quick heads-up — hitting a 404 from the onboarding quickstart -> 'env vars' anchor: https://docs.redwood.inference/quickstart#env-vars (page heading is 'Environment variables' so fragment should be `#environment-variables`). i'll open a tiny PR to fix the link and add a one-line note about secrets.
kevin: thanks for spotting this. i can review. can you paste the markdown line where the link appears?
abby: it's in templates/getting-started.md: `[env setup](../quickstart#env-vars)`
mina: i maintain that template. small PRs are fine  tag me. prefer the new one-liner to say "do not commit secrets; see playbook for KMS usage" and point to /playbooks/secrets.
doc-bot: created task docs:linkfix-2002 "quickstart env-vars anchor + secrets blurb" assigned to @mina, reported by @abby
abby: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1414 — fixes fragment, adds the one-line warning, and includes a linkcheck test.
kevin: skim looks good; left one nit about using absolute vs relative paths. mina: i'll resolve the nit and merge once CI is green. thanks for the tidy PR :thumbsup:
abby: ran a quick repo grep and found the same `#env-vars` fragment in `i18n/de/templates/getting-started.md` and a stale link in `playbooks/onboarding.md`. i'll either add them to this PR or open tiny follow-ups depending on scope.
mina: i'll take the i18n follow-up. please drop any other hits here and i'll batch them into one i18n PR.
abby: will do. thanks all — small fixes like this are nice to cherrypick between releases.
